description: Progression of strength exercises across guided gym sessions: load, sets, rest and HR recovery week after week. Each session is read once and cached in ~/.suunto-mcp/cache/ (SUUNTO_CACHE=off disables it); it writes nothing but that cache and changes nothing at Suunto. Covers `weeks` (default 8, max 26) ending at `date`. At most 8 uncached sessions are read per call (newest first): `pending` is how many remain, so CALL AGAIN until pending is 0 before drawing conclusions, unless a note says it will not help. Failed sessions are skipped and listed in `errors`. IMPORTANT: the watch records only the guide's TEXT, so weights and reps are what was PLANNED; a log_session entry replaces the label's weight (loadSource 'journal'). Without `name`: an index. With `name` (ignoring case, accents, punctuation): a sessions table (kg null when unknown, never guessed; restEndHr, restT20S and the other rest columns cover the rest after set 1 only), summary and suggestion { last, target, reason }: a next target, never pushed; the load rises by a small step only when log_session shows every planned set and rep done at ONE weight, otherwise it repeats.

date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

name.description: Exercise name, e.g. 'Back Squat'. Omit for an index.

name: get_exercise_history
title: Get exercise history across sessions
